subject: Will Anthropic pop the bubble?
notes: Body is short; most top stories are one-line teasers with no detail in the visible text.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO priced at $83 per share, about to start trading; reported $1.4tn valuation
stories.quote: Anthropic is about to start trading, the market’s first real test of a frontier AI lab going public. Deedy Das, a partner at Menlo Ventures (one of Anthropic’s early and big backers), reckons a $1.4tn valuation, which reports put its valuation before it priced at $83 per share, is probably too low.

stories.headline: Drone maker UForce raised $700m (mentioned as Menlo portfolio company)
stories.quote: In Europe, Menlo has backed vibe coding startup Lovable and drone maker UForce, which just raised $700m.

stories.headline: Boltz raises $110m Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners
stories.quote: London-based Boltz, which builds AI models for pharma and biotech researchers to design and select drug candidates, raised $110m in Series A funding. Bessemer Venture Partners led the round
stories.description: AI models for pharma and biotech researchers to design drug candidates

stories.headline: Stryx AI raises €7.7m seed led by Armand Thiberge and Impala
stories.quote: Paris-based Stryx AI, which develops radar detection and interceptor systems to neutralise hostile drones, raised €7.7m in seed funding. Armand Thiberge and Impala led the round
stories.description: Radar detection and interceptor systems to neutralise hostile drones

stories.headline: Elysian raises €12m in grants and equity
stories.quote: Hoofddorp, Netherlands-based Elysian, which develops battery-electric aircraft, raised €12m in grants and equity funding. Investors include FideFlux, SecFund, and ROM InWest.

stories.headline: Vetaion raises €5.7m pre-seed led by Visionaries Tomorrow and UVC Partners
stories.quote: Munich, Germany-based Vetaion, which automates the manufacturing of custom electrical control cabinets, raised €5.7m in pre-seed funding. Visionaries Tomorrow and UVC Partners led the round
stories.description: Automates the manufacturing of custom electrical control cabinets

stories.headline: EU Inc campaigners tell lawmakers to scrap weakened pan-European company structure plans and start over
stories.quote: EU Inc campaigners told lawmakers to abandon their “weakened” attempts to introduce a pan-European corporate structure — and start again from scratch.
stories.description: Campaign for a pan-European corporate structure

stories.quote: Helsinki, the Finnish capital home to the annual Slush conference, risks losing its crown as the country’s startup funding hotspot, according to Sifted data.
